classes.name: KGSnapshot
classes.description: A frozen state of the knowledge graph captured at a point in time.

classes.name: KGChangeSet
classes.description: The set of changes between two knowledge graph snapshots.

classes.name: KGChange
classes.description: A single change (addition, update, or deletion) of one knowledge graph object between two snapshots.

classes.name: KGNode
classes.description: The state of one knowledge graph node (class instance) within a specific snapshot. Subclass of KGObject.

classes.name: KGRelationship
classes.description: The state of one knowledge graph relationship (property instance) within a specific snapshot. Subclass of KGObject.

classes.name: KGChangeDriver
classes.description: A business reason (activity or decision) behind knowledge changes, such as a new regulation, customer feedback, or a strategic decision.
extract_rules: Extract one driver per source change and cite that single source text ID; never combine several IDs into one entry
Give related source changes the same driver label so they merge into one driver (e.g., three GDPR sticky notes all yield 'GDPR Article 17 compliance')
Use business language, not technical jargon
Be specific (not 'requirement change' but 'GDPR Article 17 compliance')
The driver must explain WHY the knowledge changed, not just WHAT changed
Typical driver categories: regulatory, customer feedback, strategic decision, technical necessity
prohibit_rules: Do not extract technical trigger names (e.g., 'miro_extraction', 'file upload') as drivers.
Do not extract mere descriptions of the change itself (e.g., 'added sticky note') without a business reason.

properties.name: beforeSnapshot
properties.description: Links a change set to the earlier snapshot it was computed from.

properties.name: afterSnapshot
properties.description: Links a change set to the later snapshot it was computed from.

properties.name: hasChange
properties.description: Links a change set to each change it contains.

properties.name: hasNode
properties.description: Links a snapshot to a node state it contains. Only objects referenced by changes are materialized.

properties.name: hasRelationship
properties.description: Links a snapshot to a relationship state it contains. Only objects referenced by changes are materialized.

properties.name: beforeNode
properties.description: Links a change to the state of the affected node in the earlier snapshot (absent for additions).

properties.name: beforeRelationship
properties.description: Links a change to the state of the affected relationship in the earlier snapshot (absent for additions).

properties.name: afterNode
properties.description: Links a change to the state of the affected node in the later snapshot (absent for deletions).

properties.name: afterRelationship
properties.description: Links a change to the state of the affected relationship in the later snapshot (absent for deletions).

properties.name: isDrivenBy
properties.description: Associates a knowledge change with the business driver that caused it.
extract_rules: Link a change to a driver only when the driver plausibly explains why that specific object was added, updated, or deleted
Match on the affected object's label and the source text of the change and the driver
A change may be linked to multiple drivers, and a driver may drive multiple changes
Leave a change unlinked when no driver explains it
prohibit_rules: Do not link a change to a driver merely because both exist in the same change set.

Do not link an UPDATE change whose diff only re-scores an existing relationship (strength, judgment, or justification) while both endpoints stay the same: that reflects re-extraction of the same knowledge, not a business decision. Additions and deletions of relationships are genuine knowledge changes and may be linked.
